# One Euro Filter

Unmodified JavaScript reference implementation by Gery Casiez, copyright 2019
Inria, BSD-3-Clause (full license in OneEuroFilter.js).

Pinned source:
https://github.com/casiez/OneEuroFilter/blob/d78925584245597f2aa9c4c01a802eb0f0b77fb9/javascript/OneEuroFilter.js

Author's paper, tuning guidance and filter comparison video:
https://gery.casiez.net/1euro/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ybZR4WRjkpM

Used locally for arm direction samples, with seconds-based capture timestamps.
No CDN or runtime network dependency. Application adapter: arm-signal.js.
